name: onboarding
title: Onboarding
summary: The first-run setup for an AI product, in four steps: the workspace, the tools the agent may use (each with its own consent and a connect that can fail or stall), what the agent may do without asking, and a first task it streams in front of you. The panel's height glides between steps, steps slide the way you're going, and every answer is handed back to save and resume.
